name: CreateManagedBackup
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork creates backup identity + durable job + command receipt + requested audit; job performs snapshot/encryption/verification later
guards: no second active create job for same instance
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; automatic duplicate boundary coalesces through job registry
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate/coalesce -> command_receipt -> backup pending row -> durable job -> audit -> commit
